gpt5_mini.html_content:
Compare Tokyo Neighborhoods: Cost, Safety & Amenities

Interactive scatter plot — bubbles sized by population, colored by safety. Configure axes, zoom, and filter ranges to explore neighborhoods like Shibuya, Shinjuku, Harajuku and more.

Scatter: Cost vs Amenities (default)

Each bubble is a Tokyo neighborhood. Touch and mouse controls supported. Select axes and use filters in the panel to the right.

Controls

Rent (¥)
Safety (crimes/1k)
Amenities (index)
Color = safety (green safer, red less safe)
Size = population
Data shown are illustrative averages for popular Tokyo neighborhoods (rent, crime, restaurant density, shopping). Use controls to compare locations.
